subject: Post-demo: alignment on buyer roles, deployment preference & SLOs
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: alignment on buyer roles, deployment preference & SLOs

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap + a few clarifying questions so we can get your procurement and architecture teams lined up: 

1) Primary decision-maker(s): you mentioned Rajiv would own procurement budget and Dr. Patel would own clinical sign-off. Can you confirm the economic buyer and the technical approver (names & emails) so we loop the right people?

2) Deployment preference: Based on the demo, what are you leaning toward — Redwood Hosted (fastest), Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity), or Private VPC/on-prem? If you have a security or data residency constraint driving that preference, please call it out.

3) SLOs & latency targets: rough guidance you gave was p95 latency ~300–400ms for small generative requests and throughput for bulk batch embedding jobs. Can you confirm acceptable p95 and p99 latencies and peak tokens/sec expectations for real-time features?

4) Procurement path & redlines: what procurement pack do we need to send (PO vs SOW)? Any contract redlines that will need legal review (data retention, audit logs, indemnity, export controls)?

5) Timeline & pilot: are you aiming for an internal pilot by end-of-Q1? If not, what is your target go-live quarter?

Attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and the standard SLA template we usually share — these are meant to accelerate procurement conversations.

Next step: propose a 30-minute procurement + security check-in next week with Rajiv & your security lead. I blocked a few 30-minute options in the HubSpot invite link below — pick one that works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

— Markus Klein
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: MAP_MedAlign_v1.pdf (1 page summary), Redwood_SLA_Template_v2.docx (redlines expected)

From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@medalign.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@medalign.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: alignment on buyer roles, deployment preference & SLOs

Thanks Markus — great summary. Quick answers below and a couple follow-ups from our side.

1) Decision-makers: correct — Rajiv is the economic buyer (cc’ed). Dr. Anjali Patel (anjali.patel@medalign.com) will own clinical validation; she’s not on this thread yet. Please include her for any data governance or clinical-safety related items.

2) Deployment: initial preference is Dedicated (reserved capacity) because we expect steady daytime traffic across our triage service and want predictable latency. Private on-prem is a possibility for Phase 2 if regulators require it.

3) SLOs: target p95 <= 350ms for single-turn generation for triage, p99 <= 700ms. For bulk embedding jobs (nightly runs) we expect ~200k tokens/hour peak.

4) Procurement: Rajiv wants a standard PO. He’ll need the following on the contract: SOC2 Type II confirmation, clear data retention and deletion terms, and a 30-day termination clause for the pilot. Legal will do redlines; expect 1–2 weeks once we respond.

5) Timeline: pilot window target = early March (Q1). Doesn’t have to be fully production.

We’ll add Dr. Patel to the procurement call if possible. Also, can you confirm whether Dedicated includes options for autoscale burst capacity and what the pricing delta versus Hosted looks like for reserved monthly commits?

Thanks — Samantha
VP Product, MedAlign
Samantha.Cole@medalign.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: alignment on buyer roles, deployment preference & SLOs — internal action items

Team — quick internal notes and asks after Samantha’s reply: 

- Confirm pricing delta for Dedicated (monthly reserved) vs Hosted for the footprint Samantha described (steady daytime traffic, ~200k tokens/hr nightly). Karthik, can you pull the Reserved tier quote and a monthly commit example? We should show cost per 1M tokens and expected burst costs.

- Security checklist: Monica, please confirm that Dedicated meets their SOC2 requirements and call out any additional evidence we’ll need (KMS integration, audit log retention periods). Also capture whether we can support the 30-day termination for pilot (legal).

- Deployment/config: Laura, can you draft a short runbook for a Dedicated pilot with autoscale burst enabled and note the latency tuning knobs (batching, KV cache warmup, kernel selection) so we can map to their p95/p99 targets.

- MAP update: I’ve attached the MAP we sent; once Karthik/Laura update the technical appendix, I’ll resend to Samantha and Rajiv and propose three procurement call times.

I’ll also reach out to Dr. Patel to add clinical safety items to the agenda — Monica, please summarize any data handling constraints we should flag for her.

Thanks — Markus

Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: alignment on buyer roles, deployment preference & SLOs — internal action items

Quick responses: 

- Security/SOC2: Dedicated is compatible with SOC2 Type II controls; we can provide the SOC2 report and KMS/HSM integration notes. For audit logs, default retention is 90 days; we can extend to 1 year on request (ops ticket). I’ll attach the evidence pack in the next email.

- 30-day termination for pilot: Legal has approved a 30-day pilot termination clause for pilots under $50k ARR; we’ll need procurement to confirm pilot budget and sign a short form PO.

- Autoscale burst: Laura, our runtime supports burst pools for Dedicated — typical config is a base reserved capacity + 2x burst nodes for spiky daytime traffic. I’ll work with Pricing to produce a delta against Hosted and send a sample quote by EOD tomorrow.

Laura — please include the latency tuning items in the runbook so we can map knobs to Samantha’s p95/p99 targets.

— Monica
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
